questions.author: agent
questions.body: Q1 — External fines GL mapping (confirm before I write the design doc): driver escrow=LIABILITY, driver receivable=asset (Driver Cash Advance), fine payable=liability. One JE per violation line or one JE per fine? Deduction hits settlement via FLSA net-pay floor + written-consent gate? REC: one JE per fine w/ per-line detail; deduction gated by 10% net-pay floor + consent.

Everything with money lands on the ledger (double-entry), categorization human-confirmed. (Jorge 2026-07-03)
The tracker row is enough to authorize standard-pattern fixes; a before→after preview is required only for judgment-heavy surfaces; no per-row broken-state screenshots required. (Jorge 2026-07-03)
